comparisonScope: SHA-verified original source pixels and recorded Figma geometry from prior import/visual audits; all distinct crop/slot uses at 1920px, DPR1/DPR2, four backgrounds. Posters retain native resolution because final slots are not designed. Not a new Figma audit or implemented browser layout.
visualReview: All 26 delivered files reviewed side-by-side; native DPR2 details for snowflake, swords and Footer lettering; no noticeable new halos/blocking/chroma/edge or text-detail defects observed. Pixel/Boolean geometry is unchanged and is not baked into images.
resizeRule: Exact original aspect ratio with integer multiples of reduced source ratio; full canvases and normalized crops retained. General target >=2.2 samples/CSS pixel, capped at original. Footer text strips 3×; filtered accent/logo, already undersampled art, textures and posters native.
exceptions: Mosaic PNG delivery path and bytes preserved for existing Idiom shared-texture references and exact tiling; master separately archived.
Austin Powers poster remains source-exact JPEG: lossless repack grows; avoid another lossy generation for small savings.
11 hidden/occluded masters archived only, no public derivative; they remain available if later approved motion requires them.
Four MP4 remain unchanged; Sherlock MP4 still absent as before. Video QA/optimization is a separate task.

checks.reproduction: All 37 source checksums passed; all 26 new delivery files regenerated in memory and matched recorded SHA256/byte lengths. Idiom was not regenerated.
checks.geometry: Figma source geometry, masks, crops, filters, fills, paint order and independence are preserved; localPath metadata points to archived originals, optimizedPath separately resolves delivery files.
checks.integrity: All 37 moved originals SHA256/size match baseline and HEAD; all 9 Idiom originals and 9 Idiom delivery files unchanged. All 16 SVG, 4 fonts and 4 MP4 unchanged; no duplicate bytes within public delivery images.
